video_title: EXCLUSIVE: Mamu Calls Luka Dončić Best Offensive Player Ever - Mason & Ireland at Lakers Media Day

quotes.speaker: Sandro Mamukelashvili
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandro Mamukelashvili on his role and versatility with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I hope I can bring a lot of versatility, play different positions, stretch the floor out.
quotes.quote: I hope I can bring a lot of versatility, play different positions, stretch the floor out, be a connector as well. I love passing, I love finding my teammates, and just bring the energy as well. I think I am an energy giver. I always try to play as hard as I can, not take no plays off. I know I said a lot, but I hope I can bring a lot and help the team win as many games as possible.

quotes.speaker: Sandro Mamukelashvili
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandro Mamukelashvili on building team chemistry through open gym
quotes.excerpt: It already started, I think we have been here for two, three weeks, we have been working hard.
quotes.quote: It already started, I think we have been here for two, three weeks, we have been working hard, we have been playing open gym. But it starts also tomorrow, kind of learning plays, learning each other's tendencies and making sure we know where to find the guys and where to find them in their comfortable spots.

quotes.speaker: Sandro Mamukelashvili
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandro Mamukelashvili on playing with Luka Dončić
quotes.excerpt: He is probably the best offensive player ever, maybe, I would say, and definitely right now in the league.
quotes.quote: He is probably the best offensive player ever, maybe, I would say, and definitely right now in the league. He has basketball IQ that is off the charts. So I think just being at the right spot, I am sure he is going to find you. He is so unselfish and he is a great guy off the court as well, so I am really looking forward to getting on the court with him and making hopefully a lot of corner threes.
